title: Stars in Our Eyes
author: Susan Moffett
problems: Row 7 "butterfly whirl" can't start from where the dancers are: A butterfly whirl ends on a side; this couple is in the middle.
Row 9 "partners swing" can't start from where the dancers are: A swing that ends facing across must start nearer one side.
Row 1 "slice left and straight back" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 (couple 1) must stand on a side line.
The progression after row 1 "slice left and straight back" doesn't work out: Couple 1 must face the same way to find new neighbors.
Row 3 "star left 4 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A star of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
choices: Slice: half the counts on the diagonal, half straight back.
A star with no grip named is a basket star (wrist grip).
A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.
